wikipedia.notes: Two gunmen committed a mass shooting against a Christian Orthodox Church in Hammoud, Karak governorate, Jordan. The attack occurred during a funeral. The two attackers fled the scene.
A gunmen drove his car across Trappes and La Verrière, France, committing multiple shootings. The attacker targeted immigrants at a petrol station, a medical centre and a playground.

A gunman shot and killed three of his family members inside his home, then drove his car through the Main Market Square of Krakow, where he shot bystanders. The attacker was stopped and wounded by the police, and later declared dead at the hospital. Polish authorities called the shooting an act of terrorism.
